title: Persistent vanishing of one local map pair overlap defect
statement: Under the hypotheses of finitePresentation_local_map_pair_eventually, there is a stage l ≥ k such that at every later stage the two composites in the fixed pairwise descent square have a common value on every test scheme.

source.place: limits-lemma-descend-modules-finite-presentation, Tag 01ZR (3), first proof by Zariski gluing

proof.text: Construct the defect on the quasi-compact overlap of the two affine cover members and apply finite-presentation eventual test-map vanishing; pullback and naturality identify its later-stage values with the stated two composites.

proof_origin.place: limits-lemma-descend-modules-finite-presentation, Tag 01ZR (3); defect reduction written by J1
